JN Deb, Advocate instructed by Sharifuddin Chaklader, Advocate-on-Record -For the Petitioners.

parties:
Sharifuddin Ahmed (Md) and ors ------ Petitioners
Vs.
Md Ala Uddin and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 4. The petitioner contested the suit stating, inter alia, that the suit land belonged to them and they have been in possession thereof by growing Boro and fodder grass and by grazing their cattle since time immemorial; that the Chowdhury Mirasdars filed Title Suit No. 221 of 1940 in the 3rd Court of Munif, Habigonj, for recovery of khas possession which on trial was dismissed on 24-8-1940; as against which they preferred Title Appeal No. 398 bf 1940 which after contested hearing was also dismissed on 7-1-1941 and their Second Appeal also failed and the contesting defendants continued in possession and enjoyment as before; that the raised land on 3 sides of the suit land belonged to them and that plaintiff/respondents have had no interest ever in the suit land; but they for making wrongful gain filed the suit on allegation false to their own knowledge.
